text:
Diego (Sales): Quick ask from a mid-market pilot: NovaFleet ran a big import job and the May invoice hit $16,320. Theyre asking for an early-pay discount / onboarding credit of $6,000 to be applied if they prepay a 4-month committed pilot. Can we approve? cc @Hannah @Yuri

Hannah (Finance): Need the invoice split and a clear ask: is this a discount (reduces billed amount) or a credit memo? Also need to know how this affects recognition and whether refund/recoup rules apply.

Diego (Sales): Split below (rounded):
```
- Gen tokens: $8,300
- Embeddings: $4,200
- Import bandwidth / infra surge: $2,400
- Support / onboarding services: $1,420
- TOTAL: $16,320
Proposal: Offer $6,000 as an early-pay onboarding credit applied as $1,500 credit across next 4 invoices if they prepay the 4-month pilot (min $3.5k/mo). If they don't prepay or cancel early, credit is void and recouped.
```

Yuri (RevOps): For ops: tag as contra-revenue and amortize over the 4 credit months. Also recommend we cap finance exposure at $5,000 and require prepayment before issuing any credit. Add CRM flag to pause churn workflows during pilot.

Hannah (Finance): I can approve up to $5,000 conditional on: 1) executed 4-month pilot prepay addendum uploaded to contract repo, 2) credit amortized over 4 invoices, 3) GL posting to "onboard_credits_q2", and 4) legal-approved recoup language. If sales insists on $6k, need manager escalation.

Diego (Sales): Sales accepts $5k cap and will push for prepay signature today. They say without any credit the customer will likely delay and re-evaluate other vendors.

Olive (Legal): I'll draft a short amendment: payment terms (prepay window), credit schedule, explicit clawback/recoup trigger if they fail to prepay or cancel, and remedy for disputed charges. Recommend simple clause: credit forfeited and map back as invoice charge if pilot cancelled within 60 days. Will send to legal@redwood for countersign after signature.

billing-bot: Draft credit memo created: CM-2026-990 (amount: $5,000) status: awaiting finance approval and legal countersign.

Hannah (Finance): Final: conditional approval $5,000. Billing, do not issue credit until signed addendum is uploaded and prepayment received. Yuri, please add CRM flag and block churn automations. :white_check_mark:

Yuri (RevOps): Will add flags and set renewal reminders at 30/15/7 days before pilot end. Also will verify prepayment hits ledger before billing issues CM-2026-990.

Diego (Sales): Thanks all  pushing for signature now. Will update thread when payment posts.
